title: Two-block excision for a derived enriched coend
statement:
Use small simplicial categories and weak homotopy equivalences of [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison], and enriched modules, derived coends, bars and homotopy realization of [lem-coef-derived-space-module-coyoneda]. Let $T$ be a small simplicial category whose object set is the disjoint union of sets $O_0,O_1$ and whose mapping sets from $O_1$ to $O_0$ are empty. Let $T_0,T_1$ be its full simplicial subcategories on these two sets and put $N(a,b)=T(a,b)$ for $a\in O_0,b\in O_1$, with the composition actions. Let $X:T\to\mathsf{sSet}$ and $Y:T^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathsf{sSet}$ be enriched modules, and write $X_i,Y_i$ for restriction to $T_i$. Then the action maps give a natural equivalence of homotopy types
$$\left(X_0\otimes_{T_0}^{\mathbb L}Y_0\right)\amalg^h_{X_0\otimes_{T_0}^{\mathbb L}N\otimes_{T_1}^{\mathbb L}Y_1}\left(X_1\otimes_{T_1}^{\mathbb L}Y_1\right)\simeq X\otimes_T^{\mathbb L}Y.$$
The map from the middle term to the first term uses the contravariant action $N\otimes_{T_1}^{\mathbb L}Y_1\to Y_0$, and the map to the second term uses the covariant action $X_0\otimes_{T_0}^{\mathbb L}N\to X_1$. The maps from the outside terms are the actual bar inclusions. The comparison is natural in enriched functors preserving the two blocks and in maps of modules, retains any extra enriched module variables, and commutes with composition augmentations. All sets lie in a fixed universe, empty blocks are allowed, and no local Kan or cofibrancy hypothesis on $T,X,Y$ is imposed.
